description: Icechunk ERA5 is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "energy", published or maintained by Earthmover. An analysis-ready, cloud-optimized (ARCO) edition of ERA5, the fifth-generation global reanalysis from the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) at ECMWF. Provided as a single. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag energy and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Quarterly (every three months); historical reanalysis covering 1940 to 2025. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
